findings.frozenDecision: 盛和资源 Research selection; late-reversal price state, high duration risk, mixed cross-sectional edge and recent forecast already embedding a large 2021 step-up.
findings.interpretation: The opportunity direction remained profitable, but selected-company edge was weak at 60d and became decisively inferior to rare-earth peers later. This does not justify upgrading the late-reversal setup.
findings.generalLesson: In cyclical-growth hybrids, correctly identifying the commodity/industry opportunity is insufficient; company torque and supply-quota incidence can dominate quality/forecast visibility.

findings.frozenDecision: 通威股份 Research selection; de-rated price, clear physical polysilicon scarcity and a quantitatively bridged price/cost/locked-volume engine, but no realized 2021 earnings by cutoff and broad PV timing was adverse.
findings.interpretation: The physical price/cost/locked-volume bridge generated strong absolute and benchmark-relative returns even before reported Q1 confirmation. However, the selected stock did not beat the matched basket or best control at 60d/120d, so this is not sufficient evidence that V1.2 should permit a High-priority company-engine override without realized earnings.
findings.generalLesson: A highly measurable physical-to-earnings bridge may contain useful alpha before the accounting report arrives. The current realized-only override rule may be conservative, but any relaxation must also solve peer-expression ranking and must repeat independently.

findings.frozenDecision: Auto-chip shortage / No selection because Q1 company filings and direct auto-specific earnings conversion were unavailable by March 31.
findings.label: physical_theme_without_company_evidence_fail_closed
findings.generalLesson: Do not use later Q1 filings to retroactively select a company. Physical bottleneck discovery can precede investable company evidence.

longDurationGrowthQuestion.interpretation: 2021Q1 did not produce a cutoff-bounded ordinary-growth company selection, so the prior long-duration-growth recall concern remains unconfirmed outside the 2021Q2 regime.

quantitativeBridgeQuestion.interpretation: Strong physical-to-earnings evidence before reported earnings may be useful, but one case that still lagged stronger controls cannot justify changing the realized-only company-engine override.

durableCashYieldQuestion.interpretation: No durable-cash-yield archetype was tested in this window. Keep it descriptively separate without a trading exemption.

decision.reason: The window supports V1.2's fail-closed discipline and reveals a possible pre-earnings quantitative-bridge recall issue, but neither the long-duration-growth nor quantitative-bridge failure class independently repeats strongly enough to version.
decision.nextAction: Continue unchanged V1.2 on an untouched historical window with different industries. Preserve equityReturnArchetype as descriptive metadata and continue measuring false negatives by archetype.
